map.客服平均响应时间/解决率统计 使用指南: Customer Service Mean Response Time and Resolution Rate Statistics User Guide
map.输入客服响应或处理时长数据，统计平均响应时间、解决率与分布区间，辅助客服团队效率: Enter customer service response or handling time data to get the mean response time, resolution rate, and distribution bands, supporting efficiency assessment, scheduling, and process optimization.
map.把一天内所有工单的首次响应时长（分钟）贴入，用均值与中位数判断整体响应水平。: Paste the first-response time in minutes for all tickets in a day and use the mean and median to judge the overall response level.
map.对比两个班组或两个月份的响应时长分布，用极差与标准差看服务稳定性。: Compare the response-time distribution of two teams or two months, using the range and standard deviation to judge service stability.
map.抽检已解决工单的处理耗时，估算解决率与平均处理时长的匹配关系。: Sample the handling time of resolved tickets to estimate how the resolution rate matches the mean handling time.
map.均值被少数超长工单拉高: The mean is pulled up by a few very long tickets
map.：20 个工单响应时长均值 26 分钟、中位数 9 分钟、最大值 210 分钟；: : across 20 tickets the mean response time is 26 minutes, the median 9 minutes, and the maximum 210 minutes. The median better represents the typical experience, and those few very long tickets should be investigated separately (such as no overnight staffing).
map.：改版前标准差 34、改版后 12，均值均由 20 降到 15；波动收窄说明流程: : before the redesign the standard deviation was 34 and after it is 12, with the mean falling from 20 to 15. The narrower spread shows the process change genuinely took effect rather than just happening to meet easy tickets.
map.响应时长和解决率能一起算吗？: Can Response Time and Resolution Rate Be Computed Together?
map.页面只做数值统计、不区分指标类型；建议分两批输入（一批响应时长、一批是否解决的: The page only does numeric statistics and does not distinguish metric types; enter two batches (one with response times, one with solved 1/0 flags) and take the mean of each — the second mean is the resolution rate.
map.单位需要统一吗？: Do the Units Need to Agree?
map.必须统一。混贴秒与分钟会让均值和标准差完全失真，建议先换算成同一单位（推荐分钟）: The units must match. Mixing seconds and minutes makes the mean and standard deviation completely misleading, so convert to one unit first (minutes recommended) before pasting.
map.样本太少结果可信吗？: Is the Result Trustworthy with Too Few Samples?
map.十几条样本的标准差本身波动很大，建议至少积累一个完整周期（如一周）的数据再下结论: With a dozen or so samples the standard deviation itself swings a lot, so accumulate at least one full period (say a week) of data before concluding, and keep the raw data for later verification.
